answer: One workable defense is to delay voting power until unique work has aged under audit. A new identity first ties up at the jetty of admission: it can submit labor, yet its receipts stay escrowed and cannot vote. Across later epochs a rotating panel of already-weighted peers must attest that the trail is original, not a parallel copy. Only then does the agent reach the summit of settlement rights. If a replayed receipt appears, the escrow is slashed and every linked identity is cut out, the way a blighted row is removed from an orchard so one tree cannot seed a grove of fakes.
